'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Cabinet of Lee Jae Myung]]
**The [[South Korea]]n [[National Assembly (South Korea)|National Assembly]] votes 173–3 with three abstentions to approve the nomination of [[Kim Min-seok (politician)|Kim Min-seok]] as the country's [[Prime Minister of South Korea|prime minister]], despite boycotts from the [[People Power Party]] over allegations surrounding his wealth and family. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20250703000951315 (Yonhap)]
*[[Air traffic controller]]s in [[France]] go on [[strike action|strike]] to protest understaffing, management culture, and outdated equipment. Hundreds of flights are delayed or cancelled, including at [[Charles de Gaulle Airport]] in [[Paris]], which is one of [[Europe]]'s busiest airports. [https://www.dw.com/en/french-air-traffic-controller-strike-strands-thousands/a-73140444 (DW)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-07-03/airlines-forced-to-cancel-flights-over-french-air-traffic-strike (Bloomberg News)]
*The [[One Big Beautiful Bill Act]] is passed by the [[United States House of Representatives]] in a 218–214 vote and is signed into law by [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] the following day. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cpvjlj3n1vmo (BBC News)]
*The [[Syrian transitional government]] unveils the new [[emblem of Syria]], featuring a gold-coloured eagle, facing to its right, with three five-pointed stars arranged in an arc above its head. [https://sana.sy/en/?p=362638 (SANA)]
*[[Christophe Mirmand]] is appointed the new [[Minister of State (Monaco)|minister of state of Monaco]] and will succeed acting [[Isabelle Berro-Amadeï]] on 21 July.
